section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: PART-11 SUICIDES IN INDIA Suicides A total of 44,732 suicides were reported in India during 1982 compared with the figures of 40,245 in 1981 registering an increase of 11.1 per cent in 1982 over 1981. The numerical increase registered during 1982 over 1981 was 4,487. The number of suicides in 1982 was the highest during the period of 8 years from 1975 to 1982. During the period 1975-1982, the trend in suicide cases has been erratic. It is seen from the suicide figures that during the period of 8 years, the highest number of suicides was recorded during 1982 (44,732) with a volume of 6.5 per lakh of population. If we compare the volume only, the figures generally showed a down ward trend except for 1980 but the actual figures of suicides expressed a mised trend as the figures from 1975 to 1977 showed a downward trend but registered an increase in 1978 over 1977 and then came down in 1979. These figures again went up in 1980 in comparison to the figures of 1976, 1977, 1978 and 1979 and came down again in 1981. The number of suicides further rose to the highest peak during 1982 in comparison to all the previous years under study. The detailed statistics are presented in Table I.
